name: Xanica Zapotec, 'XZ'

catalog_quote: The phonemes of XZ are listed here with orthographical symbols, where different, given in parentheses: p, t, ȼ (ts), kʸ (ky), k, kʷ (kw), β (b), d, f (only loanwords), s, š (x), z, ž (zh), m, n, ñ, ngʷ (ngw), l, r, w, y, i, e, æ (ë), u, o, a. The syllable nucleus may be a simple vowel: a; laryngealized: aˀ (aa); glottalized: aʔ (a'); or aspirated: aʰ (ah). There is contrastive tone in XZ, which is not represented in the practical orthography.
world_status: a description exists but is not accessible
sweep_summary: Santiago Xanica Zapotec is not in the catalog. The single works with stress in the title (Penner et al. 2008, LSVT prosody in Parkinson's patients, German-language clinical journal) is a Glottolog mis-assignment - its record says 'computerized assignment from \"lee\"' (Lee Silverman) - and has nothing to do with Zapotec; the 5.3 live table lists only Piper 1995 and Broadwell 2015 for sant1452. No first-hand word-stress statement for this variety was found anywhere. The closest thing read is Piper 1995 (SIL Mexico Workpapers 11, downloaded via the Internet Archive, scanned), p. 68 fn. 9: Xanica Zapotec has contrastive tone not written in the orthography and plain/laryngealized/glottalized/aspirated nuclei - silent on stress. The SIL archive holds 15 zpr items (2015 snapshot); the two that could carry a pronunciation note - 'Breve vocabulario' (1993) and 'Frases ilustrativas' (1993) - are could not be reached by automated download downloads with no archived copy at the Internet Archive; the cultural-texts scan is handwritten; the primers say nothing. The one phonological description, Piper 1990 'Del protozapoteco al zapoteco de Xanica: un estudio fonológico' (22 pp., unpublished), has no located copy and is the high-priority acquisition. they are flagged in and were not used). searching went through Crossref, archive.org, the Internet Archive, Glottolog and SIL directly.

new_statements.rule_in_words: No rule available: the only accessible first-hand phonological remark says Xanica Zapotec has contrastive tone (unwritten in the practical orthography) and says nothing about stress or accent placement. (scanned rendering of IPA symbols in the quote is approximate: ts, ky, kw, b, x, zh, ngw, ë are the orthographic equivalents shown in parentheses.)
new_statements.domain_note: Footnote-level phonological sketch in a discourse paper; concerns the phoneme inventory and syllable nucleus, not the word or phrase. No stress statement anywhere in the 12 pages.
new_statements.identity_note: Sources are all by Michael J. and Priscila Piper (SIL) on the Santiago Xanica town variety ('XZ'). Glottolog sant1452 = ISO zpr, classified Central Core Zapotec > Cisyautepequeño (sout3003) after Beam de Azcona 2004 / Campbell 2017. Ethnologue-derived alternative names on the Glottolog page include 'Zapoteco de Asunción Tlacolulita' (a different Yautepec-district town) and Campbell et al. 2022 label 8794-zpr 'Coatlán Zapotec'; treat those as name confusions, not attestations of the same variety.
